title: DetectionEvent
description: Unified detection contract emitted by every Vision backend through services/vision/boundary.py. Product Logic must not depend on detector-native IDs or runtime types.

class.description: VisionLayer canonical class name (person, car, truck, bus, motorcycle, bicycle). Never a numeric detector id.

bbox.description: Pixel bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2] in full original frame coordinates (not letterboxed inference surfaces).

track_id.description: Stable tracker identity within the current camera stream/run. Not a persistent real-world identity.

timestamp.description: Absolute Unix timestamp in seconds (fractional allowed). AI Test: base_unix_ts + video_timestamp_sec.

video_timestamp_sec.description: Seconds from the start of the source video (media timeline). Distinct from absolute timestamp.

frame_index.description: 0-based frame ordinal in the source video. Used by Event Media seeking on file sources.

frame_size.description: Original frame size [width, height] in pixels.
